title: Automated Pull Request Merge Notification and Downstream Sync
problem_summary: Pull requests are merged across multiple GitHub repositories (backend, frontend, automation-engine) without automated downstream tracking or notifications linked to the merge event.
preconditions: GitHub webhook configured for pull_request merged events
Target communication channel or tracking board integration available

steps.action: Capture pull_request_merged webhook payload from GitHub
Extract metadata including project repository, branch, and author
Post automated notification or update task status in project management/chat tool

expected_side_effects: Sending notification messages to team channels upon merge
rollback_plan: Disable GitHub webhook integration and revert notification configurations in the target channels.
blocked_reasons: No authoritative SOP provided for GitHub pull request merge notification and downstream sync.
approval_question: Do you approve this automation proposal despite the missing SOP context?
